items.html:
Saradindu Mukherjee was one of the surprise choices in the Indian team for the Asia Cup held in India in 1990-91. But in spite of playing all three matches, Mukherjee did not exactly further his cause by taking only two wickets in 29 overs. The one notable achievement was that Aravinda de Silva fell to him in both games against Sri Lanka. He played for Bengal in the Ranji Trophy for some years with modest success. He was a member of their victorious squad in 1989-90. He enjoyed a good season two years later when he was Bengal's leading bowler with 22 wickets at 21.22.
Partab Ramchand
